LESSON: VIRTUES IN ISLAM • FULFILMENT OF PROMISE • ANGER MANAGEMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.2: Virtues in Islam • Fulfilment of promise • Anger management
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Virtues in Islam • Fulfilment of promise • Anger management, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: How can Muslims manage anger? 2. Why should Muslims fulfil promises?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Virtues in Islam • Fulfilment of promise • Anger management together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: personal skills enhanced as learners discuss the Islamic teachings on fulfilment of promise and anger

management and make class presentations.

• Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing is enhanced as learners share on PowerPoint/charts/online

platforms ways in which Muslims can manage anger according to the teaching of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of open-mindedness and creativity is enhanced as learners role-play acts

depicting fulfilment of promise and anger management in the society.

Values:
• Peace is enhanced as learners research on the significance of fulfilment of promise and anger management and make notes.

• Unity is enhanced as learners discuss the Islamic teachings on fulfilment of promise and anger management in groups and

makes class presentations.

• Social justice is enhanced as learners role-play acts depicting fulfilment of promise and anger management in the society.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Social cohesion is enhanced as learners role-play acts depicting fulfilment of promise and anger management in the society.

● Self-management skills - coping with emotions as learners role-play acts depicting fulfilment of promise and anger

management in society.
